## LD decay

Pour segmenter le fichier vcf en sous fichier contenant chaqun un chromosome

for chr in chr1L chr1S chr2 chr3 chr4 chr5 chr6; do
    echo "Extraction de $chr..."
    bcftools view vfaba_afabae_n4.filtered_imputed_maf.vcf.hedin.vcf.gz | \
    awk -v chr="$chr" '($1 == chr || $0 ~ /^#/)' | \
    bgzip > ${chr}.vcf.gz
    tabix -p vcf ${chr}.vcf.gz
done

for chr in chr1L chr1S chr2 chr3 chr4 chr5 chr6; do
    echo "Conversion de ${chr}.vcf.gz en format PLINK..."
    plink --vcf ${chr}.vcf.gz \
          --double-id \
          --allow-extra-chr \
          --chr-set 30 \
          --make-bed \
          --out ${chr}_plink
done

for chr in chr1L chr1S chr2 chr3 chr4 chr5 chr6; do
    echo "Calcul du LD pour ${chr}..."
    plink --bfile ${chr}_plink \
          --r2 \
          --ld-window 99999 \
          --ld-window-kb 1000 \
          --ld-window-r2 0 \
          --out ${chr}_ld
done


for chr in chr1L chr1S chr2 chr3 chr4 chr5 chr6; do
    echo "Extraction des distances et r² pour ${chr}..."
    tail -n +2 ${chr}_ld.ld | awk '{print ($5 - $2), $7}' > ${chr}_ld_decay.txt
done



for chr in chr1L chr1S chr2 chr3 chr4 chr5 chr6; do
    echo "Calcul des moyennes de r² par intervalles de 10 kb pour ${chr}..."
    awk '
    {
        bin = int($1 / 10000) * 10000;  # Intervalle de 10 kb
        sum[bin] += $2;
        count[bin]++;
    }
    END {
        for (bin in sum) {
            print bin, sum[bin] / count[bin];
        }
    }' ${chr}_ld_decay.txt > ${chr}_ld_decay_binned.txt
done
